name: IHIStatus
title: IHI Status
description: This extension applies to the [Identifier](http://hl7.org/fhir/datatypes.html#identifier) data type and is used to represent the status of the associated Individual Healthcare Identifier (IHI) and indicates whether the status of the IHI is active or otherwise.

element.definition: IHI number status associated with an IHI identifier.
IHI number status associated with an IHI identifier.
element.comment: This concept is equivalent to Australian Institute of Health and Welfare data element 743466 [Identifier—identifier status, Individual Healthcare Identifier number status code N](https://meteor.aihw.gov.au/content/index.phtml/itemId/743466).
